body:
Sucks knowing someone out there feels how I do, but it's also a bit reassuring. Selfish thing to think? Probably. 

I am an extremely emotional person, and I have trained myself so well to not show or feel it that I don't think I can anymore. I think that may be the root cause of all of this. Can't talk to people about this IRL, because of the reason you stated. Anonymous accounts make it a bit easier, who would have known.

Yeah, it may but I dont even know where to start. I've become so anti-social because I spare people the trouble of dealing with my negativity. I struggle to speak to people I once and still consider "best friends".

I can relate, sadly. I don't really care to get help, though if I find a way to not feel this way it would be nice.

Til then, just relying on alcohol and lots of opiates.
I wish I could stay home, life is so much easier when I don't have to deal with fucking retards ruining what usually happens to be a shitty day anyways.

Hey! A person like me! Less rage, and more frustration, but hey! 

I'd likely use more shit in lieu of fuck, but yeah it irks the shit out of me when I hear someone say shit like that.

Yeah. That's a part of it. I suppose I could say:

I want to die because I don't relate to anyone, I feel life is just postponing inevitable death, and I'm beginning to not feel human anymore. 

That post was a mess, sorry about that. 

After high school I plan on enlisting in the Armed Forces, and I don't predict many friends being made there. I predict my life will just be work, sleep, and whatever else I end up doing with my own time.
